name: app-light-and-dark-pill-nav-bars-and-header-components
title: Light and Dark Pill Header Components
whatItIs: A split image of six pill-shaped header bars in a cream and white version on the left and black on a taupe field on the right: back, menu with search, search with filter, profile with a notification bell, back with cancel and done, and a logo with a menu icon.
whatItMeans: The paired themes show the system's flexibility, and the pill shape keeps every header friendly and consistent.
techniques: Same components in light and dark side by side
Coloured text actions (pink cancel, green done)
Small notification dot on the bell
Logo with a soft glow in the dark version

vocabulary.definition: A rounded capsule holding navigation controls.
Light and dark versions of a component shown together.
A coloured word button such as Cancel or Done.
